title: Meri jaan Ali Akbar (AS)
body:
Meri jaan Ali akbar
Zainab ne keha khaime ki chaddar ko utah kar
Meri jaan ali akbar meri jaan ali akbarx2

Nazukh hai badan dasht hai tapta huwa sehra

Pauongi sukun kaise bataa tujse bichar kar

Chalne se tere chalti hai beta meri saanse

Ab dilko kahan taab ke betaab hai darkan

Ajaa tera chera mei nigaho mei basaalu

Kuch pal mei ujar jaayega zehra ka bhara ghar

Chin jayegi masum sakina ke bhi gohar

Yeh soch ke marjati hu jab koi na hoga
Aghyaar ke majme mei sedaa kon sunega
Darbaar mei jaungi mei bazaar se hokar

Zainab ka tha noha ye beyabaane kezaa mei
Quran bikhar jayega ab dashte belaa mei
Rehjaungi tanha nahi hoga koi yawar
